verdict.rationale: Browser Use Cloud lets an agent submit a goal with `client.runs.create(...)` and get back `run.result` [docs-1, docs-20, docs-3]. Progress and completion can be monitored by polling `runs.events()` with a cursor [docs-5, docs-14], while Browser Use runs the browsers (hardened Chromium, proxies, CAPTCHA solving) on its side [docs-6, docs-22, docs-27]. The core story is covered, but only through the SDK; the raw HTTP API surface is thin, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: webhook delivery of results, documented raw HTTP endpoints/OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the hosted run API.
